title: Teton Village, Death Canyon, and Jenny Lake
summary: Hike to Phelps Lake, boat across Jenny Lake to Inspiration Point, then explore String Lake and Jackson.

segments.blurb: Breakfast, Teton Village, then Death Canyon hike to Phelps Lake.

expect.arrive: Teton Village is a small alpine-style base area with cafes right off the parking; Death Canyon Trailhead is a dirt/gravel lot at the end of a bumpy unpaved road past the Rockefeller Preserve.
expect.parking: Death Canyon Trailhead lot is small (room for roughly 20-25 cars) and can fill by mid-morning on weekends in good weather; the Preserve Center has a larger paved lot a short drive before it.

paths.do: Persephone Westbank and a walk around Teton Village, skip the hike.
Village, then drive to the Preserve Center and walk a few minutes onto the trail without going to the full overlook.
Village, then the out-and-back to Phelps Lake Overlook from Death Canyon Trailhead.

alt: Teton Village Jackson Hole base area
segments.seasonal: The Jackson Hole Aerial Tram at Teton Village runs through October 4, 2026, so it is still operating on this date if they want a ride up the mountain instead of the hike.

expect.arrive: Jenny Lake Visitor Center sits above a large paved lot that fills by mid-morning in September; the shuttle boat leaves from a dock a short walk below the visitor center and runs continuously, no reservation.
expect.parking: Jenny Lake's main lot is one of the busiest in the park; if it is full there is overflow parking a short walk further from the dock.

paths.opt: Boat there and back, no hike
paths.do: Round-trip boat ride across and back without leaving the west dock.
One-way or round-trip boat, then the climb to Inspiration Point and back to the dock.

paths.do: Hike the South Jenny Lake Trail around to Inspiration Point and back without the boat.

segments.seasonal: The Jenny Lake shuttle boat's 2026 season ends September 30 and narrows to 9am-5pm from September 8 onward, so it is running but on shortened hours on this date (jennylakeboating.com).

expect.arrive: Jenny Lake Road is a one-way scenic loop with pull-outs; String Lake Picnic Area has a gravel/paved lot right at the shallow, warm south end of the lake, popular with families.
expect.parking: String Lake's lot is moderate-sized and fills on warm weekend afternoons; arriving mid-afternoon on a Sunday should be fine.

paths.do: String Lake Picnic Area, Cathedral Group Turnout, and the roadside overlooks, no lake walk.
Walk part of the String Lake shoreline out and back instead of the full loop.
The complete flat loop trail around the lake.

expect.arrive: Jackson Town Square is compact and entirely on foot, with the four antler arches at the corners; the wildlife art museum is a short drive north of downtown.
expect.parking: Downtown Jackson has metered street parking plus a few public lots; it's tightest right around dinner time.

paths.do: Square, dinner, then a drink at the Million Dollar Cowboy Bar.
Squeeze in the wildlife art museum before it closes, then dinner and the square.
